model_annotation: Figure 3(a) shows a line plot illustrating the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different models. The x-axis represents the number of completions, labeled as "Number of completions (k)", with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to around 64, and marked with regular tick labels at intervals of 8, but the units are not specified. The y-axis represents coverage, labeled as "Coverage", with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to around 1, and marked with regular tick labels at intervals of 0.2, but the units are not specified. The plot displays three lines: one in blue representing Llama-1B, one in green representing Llama-1B + FT, and another light green line representing another Llama-1B + FT. Starting at approximately 0.1 coverage at 0 completions, coverage increases steadily to approximately 0.95 at 64 completions for Llama-1B. For Llama-1B + FT, coverage starts at around 0.35 and increases to approximately 0.95 at 64 completions. The second Llama-1B + FT line starts at 0.35 and rises steadily to nearly 1.0 at 64 completions.
